name: TPG Inc.
moat_justification: Top-tier diversified alternative manager: $327B AUM (+25% YoY), fee-earning AUM $181B with a $39B not-yet-fee-earning pipeline, record fundraising momentum ($26B in H1 2026 toward a >$50B year) and FRE margin expanding to 50% in Q2 2026 — capped at moderate-strong because LPs re-bid every vintage against equally scaled rivals, the earnings mix still leans on cyclical PE realizations, recent growth is partly acquired (Angelo Gordon, Peppertree), and unit count creeps +6.6%/yr. The filing-derived ROIC and gross-margin series are null for this filer (no operating-income or COGS tags; the consolidated balance sheet mixes fund assets), so the moat rests on the observable franchise margins — FRE margin and fee-related EBITDA margin — instead. A 6 gives CAP 9.8 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 6.6%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-17, accession 0001880661-26-000011), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Purchases of fixed assets': $(28,802) thousand for FY2025, with $(28,131) thousand for FY2024 and $(16,728) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement (all in $ thousands). The line is tagged in the filing's inline XBRL under us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets, which the engine does not read, with identical values in EDGAR companyfacts.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

IRR_AT_FLOOR: implied IRR sits within 0.5pp of terminal growth 2.5% (super_bear, bear) — a perpetuity growing at g has an IRR above g at any price, so the model cannot express a return below ~2.5%; this price is beyond the model's range and the expected return is 'at most ~3.0%', not the recorded figure
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.51 vs 3-yr median 0.12 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 0.3% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 20.7x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Top-tier diversified alt manager, moat 6/10 — standardized Tier D (weighted IRR 3.23%, IV@15% $1.93 at $42.20) is a definition artifact: consolidated-fund OCF plumbing plus a full equity-comp charge crush the engine base to $0.12/share, while on the manager's distributable-earnings definition (~$2.78/unit TTM) the same scenarios print Tier B and clear 15% at ~$46 (~$37 with a 20% margin of safety); sector misfit, confidence low.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: sector model misfit; tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Scale and brand in buyout — a founding mega-fund franchise (1992) with $327B AUM (+25% YoY at Q2 2026) and LP relationships re-upped through many cycles
Durable, growing fee core — fee-earning AUM $181B plus $39B of AUM not yet earning fees as a visible pipeline; perpetual capital rose to 14% of fee-earning AUM
FRE margin expansion proves operating leverage — fee-related earnings +43% YoY in Q2 2026 at a 50% quarterly margin; Fitch TTM fee-related EBITDA margin 47.9%

Diversification and distribution — Capital, Credit (Angelo Gordon / Twin Brook), Real Estate and Market Solutions, plus wealth and insurance channels (Jackson Financial partnership: $12B of fee-earning AUM over five years)
moat_against: No structural pricing power — LPs re-bid every vintage against Blackstone/KKR/Apollo/Ares/Brookfield, and the mix shift toward credit compresses fee rates
Carry and realization cyclicality — PE-heavy earnings depend on exit windows; the 2026 sector selloff took the stock from ~$70 to $42 on exit/credit/AI-software fears, not on TPG's own prints
Growth partly bought, not only earned — Angelo Gordon (closed Nov 2023) and Peppertree (closed Jul 2025) stepped AUM and revenue up inorganically; integration and contingent-consideration risk
Partner economics dilute the per-share claim — diluted units +6.6%/yr (308.9M in FY2022 to 374.1M in FY2025, 384.6M TTM) and equity comp of $813,741,000 in FY2025

overrides.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-17, accession 0001880661-26-000011), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Purchases of fixed assets': $(28,802) thousand for FY2025, with $(28,131) thousand for FY2024 and $(16,728) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement (all in $ thousands). The line is tagged in the filing's inline XBRL under us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets, which the engine does not read, with identical values in EDGAR companyfacts.
